notes.general_comments:
There were 888 candidates with a mean score of 11.7. The low mean percentage score of 39% on this paper
would suggest that many candidates found it challenging. Four of the 30 items, Questions 5, 19, 20 and 22,
had facility scores below the 25% guessing level. Low discrimination scores indicate that even some of the
better candidates were resorting to guesswork in Questions 28 and 30. There were a further seven
questions, 6, 9, 11, 14, 18, 25, and 27, where more candidates opted for one of the distractors than for the
key, although the discrimination scores suggest that these were mostly weaker candidates.
